title: Fix tauri.conf.json schema error by removing unexpected windows block from build section
author: agent-developer (Level 1)
summary: Removed invalid 'windows': {'staticVCRuntime': true} object from 'build' section in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json. In Tauri v2 schema, 'windows' is not a valid property of 'build' and caused 'tauri build' to fail schema validation with 'Additional properties are not allowed ('windows' was unexpected)'.
diff_summary: src-tauri/tauri.conf.json: removed invalid 'windows': {'staticVCRuntime': true} block from 'build' section. The 'build' section now strictly contains only valid Tauri v2 properties: beforeDevCommand, devUrl, beforeBuildCommand, frontendDist.
